 How does the HbA1C level relate to the average blood glucose levels?
The correlation between HbA1C and average glucose level is very high (r = 0.92). The ADAhas 
recommended that clinical laboratories report the estimated average glucose (eAG) as well as A1C 
levels. Table 8-4 provides corresponding eAG in mg/dL and in mmol/L for various HbA1c levels.
